_comment: The website's public pages: the ones written for anyone to read, listed in /sitemap.xml so search engines find them (2026-11-02, docs/design/front-door.md 4.5). Data, not code: a page is a row. `node scripts/gen-sitemap.js` writes web/sitemap.xml from this file, and scripts/tests/robots-web.test.js fails when the two differ, when a row names a page that does not exist, or when web/robots.txt keeps a crawler off a listed page. A page that is a person's own (settings, identity, notes) or the admins' is never listed here; robots.txt keeps crawlers off those. The site is CC0, so every page here may be read, copied and indexed by anyone.
